text: ravi: dropped a tiny experiment for chart compacting when panels get narrow. main pain: axis tick labels and unit abbreviations collide with legends. thoughts? zoe: can you link the frame? hard to visualize. ravi: https://www.figma.com/file/abc — two variants: A shows compact units (1.2M) and single-line legends with ellipses, B shows full numbers but stacked legends. added a micro smoothing toggle in the header too. omar: prefer A for density. but we must make sure the abbreviated numbers are accessible. aria-label on the element pls. clare: +1 on aria-label. also prefer default smoothing OFF. if users opt in they understand it's altered. zoe: accessibility thought: when we hide full number behind hover, keyboard users can't get hover. make the number focusable and expose a visible tooltip on focus. ravi: sample snippet I used: 1.23M. is spelled-out ok? omar: spelled-out is good. avoid role="img" for numeric content. clare: on outliers current mock dims outliers by lowering opacity. that hides the event. what if we cap at a percentile and add a clear overflow badge at top-right of the chart? clicking it opens a small flyout with exact values. zoe: love the badge. microcopy proposal for badge tooltip: "Value clipped at 99th percentile. View full range." shorter action: "View full range". omar: agree. also render the clipped spike as a dashed stub so trend still shows. keyboard-accessible badge with aria-expanded toggles the flyout. ravi: design task: try badge as a + icon vs chevron. which is more discoverable? clare: + icon reads as add to me; chevron implies more. maybe a small capped badge with "..."? unsure. vote: react :thumbsup: for chevron, :heart: for +, :thinking_face: for ellipsis. zoe: implementation note: prefer chevron with aria-label "value clipped: 12,345,678". the flyout should contain the spelled-out number for screen readers too. omar: perf note: drawing dashed extensions for many series might be heavy. only draw for series that exceed cap and use canvas batching. ravi: legend behavior: keep single-line, show ellipsis and make each legend item focusable with a tooltip containing full metric name and id (for support). clare: also add a small affordance to expand legend into multi-line for power users. a tiny button "Expand" in legend header. zoe: copy nit: instead of "Expand", maybe "Show all". easier to scan. omar: QA checklist for accessibility: 1) compact numbers have aria-labels with spelled-out values 2) badge is keyboard-focusable and announces clipped value 3) flyout includes textual table of exact values 4) legend items focusable + tooltip on focus. ravi: action items: 1) design: prototype chevron badge + dashed clip + flyout 2) design/dev: implement aria-label pattern for compact numbers 3) dev: smoothing toggle default OFF, persist per-dashboard via localStorage for now 4) dev: legend single-line ellipses with focusable tooltips + "Show all" expand. zoe: i'll iterate mocks and upload. figma-bot: uploaded image 1735554333 (dashboard-compact-variantA.png) omar: i'll draft a short aria examples doc and PR for the localStorage toggle. clare: i'll add copy for the badge and the legend header. ravi: thanks team i'll post updated frames tomorrow.
